title: A check piped into a filter or masked with || true is refused for every check command
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-19, standards enforcement audit after #1521 (operator: close every standards gap for good). Evidence: r-piped-checks forbids piping a check into a filter or masking it with '|| true'; scripts/claude/piped-check.ts:30 covers only pkill/pgrep -f, so 'npm test | tail' and 'npm run fast || true' pass.
Files: scripts/claude/piped-check.ts, test/claude/piped-check.test.ts
Outcome: The Bash guard refuses a check command (contract test/fast/lint/typecheck, node --test, npm test/run, tsc, biome) piped into a filter or followed by '|| true', unless set -o pipefail precedes it or the output is redirected to a file with the exit code echoed.
Proof: node --test test/claude/piped-check.test.ts: refused and allowed forms each covered.
